cast.name: Carrie White
cast.role: Traumatized, telekinetic high school outcast pushed beyond endurance by abuse and public cruelty.
cast.look: A sixteen-year-old girl with pale skin, awkward slumped posture, unruly mousy brown hair, plain shapeless home-sewn 1970s dress, and intense frightened blue eyes.

cast.name: Margaret White
cast.role: Fanatical fundamentalist mother enforcing religious terror and self-mutilating dogma.
cast.look: A severe 45-year-old woman with gaunt features, tight graying bun, high-collared dark Victorian-style 1970s dress, and clutching a worn Bible with manic intensity.

cast.name: Sue Snell
cast.role: Remorseful popular senior attempting moral restitution by offering her prom date to Carrie.
cast.look: An attractive seventeen-year-old girl with blonde feathered 1970s hair, clean-cut preppy pastel sweater and plaid skirt, bearing a pensive and guilty expression.

cast.name: Tommy Ross
cast.role: Charismatic high school athlete and class president who genuinely respects Carrie at the prom.
cast.look: A tall, athletic seventeen-year-old boy with wavy brown 1970s hair, friendly open smile, wearing a powder-blue tuxedo with dark velvet lapels.

cast.name: Chris Hargensen
cast.role: Vindictive, wealthy ringleader whose humiliation drives her to execute the pig blood prank.
cast.look: A sharply styled seventeen-year-old girl with manicured dark hair, entitled posture, fashionable 1970s silk blouse, and a cold mocking glare.

cast.name: Billy Nolan
cast.role: Violent delinquent boyfriend who procures the pig blood and enacts sociopathic hostility.
cast.look: An aggressive nineteen-year-old hoodlum with greasy black hair, denim jacket over white undershirt, cigarette behind ear, and callous smirking gaze.
